name: Qantassaurus
sum: A two-legged plant-eating ornithopod with a short, stocky face from the Early Cretaceous of Victoria, Australia, then partly south of the Antarctic Circle.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: A dentary from Flat Rocks, near Inverloch, Wonthaggi Formation, Victoria (specimen number not read).
biology: Probably had a beak and leaf-shaped cheek teeth with eight ridges, replaced as they wore; like its close relative Leaellynasaura it ate ferns and horsetails.
author: Rich and Vickers-Rich 1999

images.artist: Matthew C. Herne, Jay P. Nair, Alistair R. Evans and Alan M. Tait
